stem:
The time, in minutes, taken by students to complete a test is modelled by the random variable $X$ with probability density function

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} -\frac{3}{4}(x-3)(x-5) & 3 \leqslant x \leqslant 5, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise.} \end{cases}$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that a randomly chosen student takes longer than 4.5 minutes to complete the test.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Without performing an integration, use your answer to part **(a)** to find $\text{P}(3.5 < X < 4.5)$.
